title: Sliding Window Maximum
statement:
Given an array of integers and a window size K, find the maximum value in each contiguous window of size K as the window slides from left to right.

There are N-K+1 windows. Use a monotonic deque for O(N) time.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and K.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: N-K+1 space-separated integers: the maximum in each window.
